tour.title: Product and Architecture
tour.description: Begin with README.md for SciSpark's purpose and feature surface, while treating it as the prototype-era overview. CLAUDE.md and the product and system design documents update that story to the current local-first loop: discover literature, digest it, persist user-owned Markdown, derive knowledge views, and ground AI workflows. Together these documents establish the product intent and trust boundaries that the code implements.

tour.title: Browser Application Shell
tour.description: The root layout installs application-wide providers and wraps every route in the responsive AppShell. The home page then coordinates the first user-facing research workspace, while AppShell supplies route-aware navigation and shared UI state. This is the browser entry surface from which every feature loop begins.
tour.languageLesson: Next.js App Router composes persistent layouts around route pages, while client components add stateful interaction only where the browser needs it.

tour.title: Local API Boundary
tour.description: The browser shell reaches privileged capabilities through local App Router handlers rather than importing filesystem or secret-owning modules. The settings route returns redacted configuration, the generic vault route blocks protected paths, and the changeset route validates mutations before applying them. Browser-safe settings helpers demonstrate the corresponding client side of this boundary.

tour.title: Vault Storage Adapters
tour.description: Below the API boundary, a common vault storage surface lets the same knowledge operations run against several backends. NodeFsVaultStorage owns confined, atomic filesystem access on the server; RemoteVaultStorage reaches that capability through local HTTP routes in the browser; and the in-memory adapter enables deterministic tests. This dependency inversion keeps storage mechanics separate from research behavior.
tour.languageLesson: A TypeScript interface can define one behavioral contract for filesystem, HTTP-backed, and in-memory implementations, letting callers depend on capabilities rather than concrete storage.

tour.title: Atomic Markdown Knowledge
tour.description: Vault types and frontmatter establish the schema of the user-owned Markdown knowledge base. Changesets validate multi-file mutations, record undo metadata, and protect reverts from conflicts, while bundles resolve wikilinks and backlinks into an indexed view. The result is a source of truth that remains readable as files but can power application-level knowledge structures.
tour.languageLesson: Frontmatter adds structured metadata to Markdown, while wikilinks encode relationships that can be resolved into backlinks and graph edges without a separate database.

tour.title: LLM Provider Foundation
tour.description: Shared LLM contracts normalize completions, usage, settings, and failures before any research skill invokes a model. Anthropic and OpenAI-compatible adapters translate vendor-specific protocols into those contracts, while server-owned settings choose configured models without exposing stored credentials. This layer makes higher workflows portable across providers.

tour.title: Skill Runtime and Metering
tour.description: Skills declare typed input and output contracts, and structured execution validates model responses against runtime schemas. The shared runner adds provider selection, retries, budget checks, metering, and run logs around those otherwise focused skills. Metering persists token and cost records to the vault and enforces daily limits, making AI use observable and bounded.
tour.languageLesson: TypeScript generics preserve each skill's input and output types at compile time, while runtime schemas protect the same boundary when model-produced JSON arrives.

tour.title: Literature Discovery and Feed
tour.description: Normalized paper records give arXiv, PubMed, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, and other sources a common vocabulary. Search validation and local routes isolate source selection and error handling, while resolution reconstructs a usable paper from identifiers or vault state. The feed workflow builds on that foundation to plan searches, remove already-known papers, rank candidates with an LLM, and cache the personalized result.

tour.title: Reader Ingest Loop
tour.description: The reader page and ReaderView turn a resolved paper into an HTML or PDF workspace with highlights, grounded Ask context, and idea capture. When the user promotes a paper into the knowledge base, the ingest route delegates to an orchestrator that analyzes, schema-routes, validates, repairs, and atomically writes the generated Markdown. Undo support closes the loop safely when an AI-assisted mutation is not accepted.

tour.title: Wiki Knowledge Derivations
tour.description: Ingested evidence becomes a linked wiki rather than a pile of isolated files. Authoring builds canonical paper pages, author skeletons, digests, and wikilink sections, and the dashboard derives shelves, recency, grouping, and statistics from the vault bundle. The wiki page presents those derived structures while keeping Markdown as the authoritative source.

tour.title: Research Graph Views
tour.description: The visualization workspace computes multiple views from the same vault-backed evidence rather than maintaining a second graph database. Knowledge-graph derivation adds similarity signals, citation derivation reconciles paper identifiers into directed edges, and the workspace coordinates filters, tabs, inspection, and the active canvas. The visualization page exposes this derived research map to the user.

tour.title: Grounded Knowledge Chat
tour.description: Grounded chat retrieves candidate vault pages, selects bounded context, assembles prompts, answers through the shared skill runtime, and degrades to deterministic selection when needed. The route streams orchestration stages to the chat page as NDJSON so the user can see progress before the final answer. Accepted question-answer pairs can then become atomic, schema-valid query notes in the vault, turning conversation back into durable knowledge.
tour.languageLesson: NDJSON sends one JSON object per line, allowing a route to stream progress events incrementally without waiting for one large response body.

tour.title: Spark Idea Engine
tour.description: Spark turns accumulated knowledge into new research directions instead of only summarizing existing papers. Its deep orchestrator combines vault context, fresh literature grounding, multiple ideation legs, novelty checks, falsification, and auditing, while the route streams progress to the Spark page. Final assembly preserves evidence and provenance in a durable research-idea Markdown page.

tour.title: Trending Research Radar
tour.description: The trend radar compares measured topic windows and corpus baselines to identify research areas that are heating up. The dashboard orchestrator derives anchors from the user's interests, ranks signals, asks an LLM for concise briefs, caches results, and degrades gracefully when sources fail. A local refresh route connects that pipeline to the Trending page, extending discovery from individual papers to field-level movement.

tour.title: Verification and Guardrails
tour.description: The final stop shows how SciSpark verifies the boundaries and workflows introduced throughout the tour. A reusable storage contract checks every vault adapter, focused chat and Spark tests exercise complex orchestration with deterministic fixtures and mocks, and browser-purity tests prevent client code from importing server-only capabilities. Vitest configures the jsdom environment and path aliases, while live, real-money LLM checks remain separately gated by the project guidance from Step 1.
